mentions.name: VineWall
mentions.description: VineWall is a network tunnel that fights doomscrolling by making the user's internet connection slower when it detects too much time spent scrolling. Current work focuses on improving the logic that decides when and how much to throttle the network.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on VineWall (https://vinewallapp.com), a network tunnel that helps you fight doomscrolling by making your internet slower when it detects you spent too much time scrolling.
